title: Concurrent standalone writes release coverage
impact: Promotes the exp 159 send-gated writer-lock pipelining shape into release write suite coverage with a paired Single Inserts (100 sequential) / Concurrent Single Inserts (100 concurrent) row pair; resqlite concurrent median drops from ~2.9 ms to ~1.1 ms on the new lane (−58% to −61%) while sequential, batch, wide batch, and transaction rows stay untouched. Makes future writer-scheduling experiments evaluable on a public release lane without relying on the focused `writer_pipelining.dart` script
